title: Bulk URL Status Checker output
description: One dataset item per checked URL that passes the output filter, plus SUMMARY and OUTPUT JSON records in the default key-value store with counts by status class.

results.title: URL status results
results.description: Default dataset items, one per checked URL (after optional filter): url, finalUrl, httpStatus, statusClass, ok, contentType, contentLength, durationMs, methodUsed, redirectCount, errorClass, error, attempts, host. Views: overview, broken.

summary.title: SUMMARY report
summary.description: Key-value store record SUMMARY (JSON): totalChecked, saved, counts by statusClass and errorClass, filter applied, durationSecs, peakMemoryMb.

output.title: Run summary (OUTPUT)
output.description: Key-value store record OUTPUT (JSON): same run summary as SUMMARY plus charged event counts and input source notes. Kept for consistency with sibling Actors.
